description: This file defines a React functional component 'TodoItem' which represents a single todo item with functionalities including inline editing, toggling completion, and deletion. It manages local state for editing mode and input value, and interacts with parent components via callback props.

methods.name: TodoItem({ task, onToggle, onDelete, onEdit, busy })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a todo item with editing, toggle, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving the edited task title, calling onEdit if changed, and toggling editing mode off.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events for saving (Enter) or canceling (Escape) the edit.
